items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: It’s like Mancini said... Mancini was that way too... Mancini told me that...

ctx.x: Wow. What did you expect from him? Did you trust him to come to you and say, “Listen John, measure 46 you’ve got this note that, I don’t think it’s what you want. Would he do that?

No he would just say something’s wrong there. Or I don’t like that section cut it out. And you’d have to do it. It’s like Mancini said, it’s like giving up one of your children but you © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
have to do it, you can’t fall in love with every note you write. Because he knows more than you do about what he’s presenting.
